feynman_certification.listener_verdict: The hook is fire—calling out the KV cache bloat immediately hits home because everyone dealing with inference knows that pain. I didn't swipe because you didn't waste time with 'Hey guys.' However, in Beat 3, you threw 'Q Premix' and 'Linear Postmix' at me without explaining if those are standard operations or your own custom implementation. I get the 'why' (saving memory), but the 'how' feels like a black box for a second.
